# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are provided for the current `main` branch and the latest published release.
Older releases are not supported.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues or discussions.

Report potential vulnerabilities privately using
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/YxOct/yxoct-mail-backend/security/advisories/new).

Include as much of the following information as possible:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- The affected endpoints, components, or versions
- Steps to reproduce or a minimal proof of concept
- Any suggested remediation

Please avoid accessing, modifying, or deleting data that does not belong to you while
investigating a potential vulnerability.

The maintainers will acknowledge the report as soon as reasonably possible, investigate it,
and provide updates through the private advisory. Please keep the vulnerability confidential
until a fix or coordinated disclosure is available.
